title: Federal odometer disclosure - basics
facts: Federal law prohibits odometer tampering and requires mileage disclosures in many vehicle ownership transfers.
For model year 2011 and newer vehicles, federal odometer disclosure requirements generally continue for the first 20 years of the vehicle's life.
For model year 2010 and older vehicles, the prior federal exemption generally begins after 10 years.
State title documents and transfer procedures implement these requirements and can contain additional rules.
